latestVersion.changelog:
AI Subtitle Japanese 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly add accurate Japanese subtitles to your uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Simple cloud setup: automatic token acquisition; just upload and go, no manual configuration.
- Clear, step-by-step workflows: upload, generate Japanese subs, preview, and export as 1080p MP4.
- Supports multiple export/media formats and batch processing.
- In-app command routing for video export, credits, project state, upload, and generation via natural prompts.
- Robust error handling with clear feedback for file type, size, credits, and rate-limiting issues.
